chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a hushed low A drone fades up from silence and one high bell note sounds alone like the last lantern in the sky}
positive_styles: low dark string pad and soft drone
fragile high bell and soft pulse-wave lead fragment
foreboding, hushed, a little sorrowful with a thin thread of hope
spacious and uncluttered, lots of rests

chunks.text:
[Theme]
{the fragile bell and soft lead play a hopeful rising leap that reaches past the tonic and is left hanging into rests, never settling home; the low pad sighs beneath}
positive_styles: low dark string pad and soft drone
fragile high bell and soft pulse-wave lead fragment
foreboding, hushed, a little sorrowful with a thin thread of hope
spacious and uncluttered, lots of rests

chunks.text:
[Theme Reprise]
{the rising phrase again, a thin sustained string thread now joining underneath, the harmony darkening through F and the raised G sharp pulling toward E}
positive_styles: low dark string pad and soft drone
fragile high bell and soft pulse-wave lead fragment
foreboding, hushed, a little sorrowful with a thin thread of hope
spacious and uncluttered, lots of rests

chunks.text:
[The Lights Go Out]
{contrast: the stars fall one by one, a slow descending line in low strings over D minor, soft distant timpani strokes, the bell falls silent}
positive_styles: low dark string pad and soft drone
fragile high bell and soft pulse-wave lead fragment

chunks.text:
[Theme Return]
{the fragile rising phrase returns once more over the drone, still unanswered; the last bar rests on a low E that pulls straight back into the theme, no ending}
